newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS SPOTLIGHT-BRIEF PROFILE OF TIM HENMAN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS SPOTLIGHT-BRIEF PROFILE OF TIM HENMAN.

text.p: Brief profile of Tim Henman, 6-7 6-3 6-2 4-6 14-12 winner over Dutchman Paul Haarhuis in the third round of the men's singles at Wimbledon on Sunday:
The first Briton to be seeded at Wimbledon for 15 years, Henman is currently ranked 20th in the world after a remarkable 12 months.
His rise began when he beat Russia's Yevgeny Kafelnikov in last year's first round en route to the last eight at the All England Club.
He went on to take a silver medal in doubles at the Atlanta Olympics and then won his first tour title in Sydney in January, after being voted the ATP's most improved player of 1996.
Injury has subsequently hampered his progress, but his form back at Wimbledon has already justified his installation as 14th seed.
Seeded: 14. Age: 22. Plays: right-handed. Weight: 70kg. Height: 1.85m. Ranking: 20. Tournament wins: 1. Head-to-head (win-loss, including Sunday's match) 2-0. Career prize money: $1.4 million.
